data.title: Amali Island
data.about:
Embark on a journey to Amali Island in The World Islands Dubai. This unique destination, crafted by Amali Properties, introduces the extraordinary Amali Island Beachfront Villas, offering an unparalleled living experience. Amali Island, known as one of the world islands, represents a pinnacle of engineering, connecting two islands in a display of architectural mastery. 

Within this iconic development, Amali Island presents 24 ultra-luxury, 5 to 7 bedroom villas, each designed to embody the essence of coastal elegance. Thanks to a partnership with ELASTIC, the Amali Island villas showcase a harmonious blend of design and natural beauty, offering two distinct yet seamless facades.

The interiors, envisioned by Hirsch Bedner Associates (HBA), reflect a diverse range of global aesthetics, with each villa on the world islands boasting materials sourced from across the globe. HBA's detailed research ensures that every aspect of the interiors aligns with Amali Island's natural setting. Complementing this, Amali Properties' commitment to sustainability is evident in their collaboration with SquareM, designing tranquil spaces for relaxation on Amali Island in The World Islands Dubai.

characteristics_module.title: Feel the Melody of the Sea at Amali Island
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Amali Island in The World Islands Dubai covers an expansive 1,200,000 sqft.
  • Offers up to 50m of private beachfront at Amali Island Villas.
  • Provides 360-degree views of the sea, Dubai skyline, and Palm Jumeirah from Amali Island.
  • Features 24 exclusive residences in the world islands.
  • Includes private berths for direct access at Amali Island villas.
  • Villas have ceiling heights between 5m and 10m on Amali Island of the worlds.
  • Mainland docking and parking available for Amali Island residents.
  • Resort-style water sports facilities in the world Island.
  • Exclusive private boat and floating helipad for residents.
  • A marina for large vessels on Amali Island in The World Islands Dubai.
  • Easily accessible from any Dubai port.
  • Two exterior styles, 'Grande' & 'Minima', and two interior themes, 'Terra' & 'Ultra', for bespoke living at Amali Island.
